#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Convert customer_report.docx to PDF and email it to bob@example.com.

Prerequisites:
  pip install python-docx

PDF Conversion requires ONE of the following:
  - LibreOffice (recommended): https://www.libreoffice.org/download
  - Microsoft Word (macOS only, via appscript): pip install appscript

Usage:
  python send_customer_report.py

You will be prompted for your SMTP credentials (email password/app password).
"""

import os
import sys
import subprocess
import platform
import smtplib
import getpass
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email import encoders

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Configuration — update these to match your setup
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
DOCX_PATH = "docs/customer_report.docx"          # Path to the .docx file
PDF_PATH = "docs/customer_report.pdf"             # Output PDF path

SMTP_SERVER = "smtp.gmail.com"                    # e.g. smtp.gmail.com, smtp.outlook.com
SMTP_PORT = 587                                   # 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL
SENDER_EMAIL = "your_email@gmail.com"             # Your email address
RECIPIENT_EMAIL = "bob@example.com"               # Recipient
EMAIL_SUBJECT = "Customer Activity Report"
EMAIL_BODY = (
    "Hi Bob,\n\n"
    "Please find the Customer Activity Report attached as a PDF.\n\n"
    "Best regards"
)


# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Step 1: Convert .docx to .pdf
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
def convert_with_libreoffice(docx_path, output_dir):
    """Convert using LibreOffice (works on Windows, macOS, Linux)."""
    # Common LibreOffice binary names/paths
    candidates = ["libreoffice", "soffice"]
    if platform.system() == "Darwin":
        candidates.append("/Applications/LibreOffice.app/Contents/MacOS/soffice")
    elif platform.system() == "Windows":
        candidates.append(
            r"C:\Program Files\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe"
        )

    for binary in candidates:
        try:
            subprocess.run(
                [binary, "--headless", "--convert-to", "pdf",
                 "--outdir", output_dir, docx_path],
                check=True,
                capture_output=True,
            )
            return True
        except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
            continue
    return False


def convert_docx_to_pdf(docx_path, pdf_path):
    """Try available methods to convert .docx → .pdf."""
    if not os.path.isfile(docx_path):
        print(f"Error: '{docx_path}' not found.")
        sys.exit(1)

    output_dir = os.path.dirname(pdf_path) or "."

    print(f"Converting '{docx_path}' to PDF...")

    # Attempt 1: LibreOffice
    if convert_with_libreoffice(docx_path, output_dir):
        # LibreOffice names the output based on the input filename
        lo_output = os.path.join(
            output_dir,
            os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(docx_path))[0] + ".pdf",
        )
        if lo_output != pdf_path:
            os.rename(lo_output, pdf_path)
        print(f"✔ PDF created: {pdf_path}")
        return

    # Attempt 2: pandoc (requires pdflatex or wkhtmltopdf)
    try:
        subprocess.run(
            ["pandoc", docx_path, "-o", pdf_path],
            check=True,
            capture_output=True,
        )
        print(f"✔ PDF created: {pdf_path}")
        return
    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        pass

    print(
        "Error: Could not convert to PDF.\n"
        "Please install one of the following:\n"
        "  • LibreOffice  — https://www.libreoffice.org/download\n"
        "  • pandoc       — https://pandoc.org/installing.html\n"
    )
    sys.exit(1)


# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Step 2: Email the PDF
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
def send_email(pdf_path):
    """Send the PDF as an email attachment via SMTP."""
    if not os.path.isfile(pdf_path):
        print(f"Error: PDF not found at '{pdf_path}'.")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"\nPreparing to send '{pdf_path}' to {RECIPIENT_EMAIL}...")
    print(f"SMTP server: {SMTP_SERVER}:{SMTP_PORT}")
    print(f"Sender:      {SENDER_EMAIL}\n")

    password = getpass.getpass("Enter your email password (or app password): ")

    # Build the email
    msg = MIMEMultipart()
    msg["From"] = SENDER_EMAIL
    msg["To"] = RECIPIENT_EMAIL
    msg["Subject"] = EMAIL_SUBJECT
    msg.attach(MIMEText(EMAIL_BODY, "plain"))

    # Attach the PDF
    with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
        attachment = MIMEBase("application", "pdf")
        attachment.set_payload(f.read())
        encoders.encode_base64(attachment)
        attachment.add_header(
            "Content-Disposition",
            f"attachment; filename={os.path.basename(pdf_path)}",
        )
        msg.attach(attachment)

    # Send
    try:
        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_SERVER, SMTP_PORT) as server:
            server.starttls()
            server.login(SENDER_EMAIL, password)
            server.sendmail(SENDER_EMAIL, RECIPIENT_EMAIL, msg.as_string())
        print(f"✔ Email sent successfully to {RECIPIENT_EMAIL}")
    except smtplib.SMTPAuthenticationError:
        print(
            "Error: Authentication failed.\n"
            "If using Gmail, generate an App Password at:\n"
            "  https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords"
        )
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error sending email: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)


# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Main
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
if __name__ == "__main__":
    convert_docx_to_pdf(DOCX_PATH, PDF_PATH)
    send_email(PDF_PATH)
